# row space of a matrix　`def.row-space`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.row-space)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.row-space.md)

## Notes · **draft**
The row space lives in $K^{n}$ (a row has length $n$), while the column space lives in $K^{m}$ — in general they are **not the same space**, so do not confuse them.

Dimension: $\dim \operatorname{Row}(A) = \operatorname{rank} A$ (the row rank equals the rank of the matrix).

The row space and the solution space of the homogeneous system are orthogonal: $x \in \ker A$ if and only if $x$ is orthogonal to every row vector; hence $\dim \operatorname{Row}(A) + \dim \ker A = n$.
